messages:
Ana CSM: Hey team — kicking off Skyline Retail onboarding. Quick sync to confirm stakeholders, success criteria, and a 30-day timeline. Can folks confirm availability for a 30-min kick today?
Mike AE: I can do 2pm PT. Ben (Skyline) is that okay?
Ben (Skyline): 2pm PT works for me. Thanks!
Sophia PM: Agenda idea: 1) roles & contacts, 2) success metrics, 3) data/access, 4) milestones + blockers. Keep it tight. :+1:
Devon Eng: I'll be there. I'll bring notes on sample API integration and rate expectations.
Ana CSM: Great — bringing a proposed success criteria list: 
- 2x queries/s sustained for demo flows
- end-to-end generate latency < 600ms for 95th pct
- embeddings sync for search working on dev dataset
- first user feedback loop in 30 days
Any edits?
Mike AE: Add renewal risk flag: if integration isn't sending logs by day 10 we trigger weekly exec updates.
Sophia PM: Also add a quality gate: pass 80% of our eval prompts (small sanity set) before production rollout.
Ana CSM: Updated — will share doc after call.
Ops Bot: Deploy bot: new kickoff meeting created: https://redwood.example.com/meet/2167890123 
Devon Eng: For access, please create a service account and share the key in the secure vault. Sample curl to test once keys are up:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-rlm-1","input":"hello"}'
```
Ben (Skyline): I'll request the service account with our IT today and ping when it's done.
Ana CSM: Timeline proposal: 
- Day 0: kickoff + roles
- Day 3: creds + dev sandbox access
- Day 7: first integration smoke test
- Day 14: embeddings sync + evaluation
- Day 30: production pilot (limited traffic)
Does that look realistic?
Devon Eng: Yes, assuming we have keys by day 3. If delays, move smoke test to day 10.
Mike AE: I'll follow up with Ben's IT to speed up the service account request.
Ben (Skyline): Noted — IT tends to take 48h, I'll nudge them.
Sophia PM: Action items: 
- Ana: share kickoff doc + success criteria (today)
- Mike: intro to IT contact (today)
- Ben: request service account (today)
- Devon: integration checklist + sample tests (after creds)
Ana CSM: OK team — see you 2pm PT. I'll post the meeting notes and the doc link in this thread afterwards. :sparkles:
